HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

2. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   C. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   C. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.
   D. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   D. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

8. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   D. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   D. Treat Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   C. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.

11. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.
   D. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   C. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Inclusivity and Interdependence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
